question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A person who repairs shoes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cobbler**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cobbler"** refers to a person who repairs shoes. (जूते बनाने या मरम्मत करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The cobbler fixed the broken sole of my shoe within an hour.
 
 
• **Cobbler** is the correct term to describe a professional who works on repairing or making shoes.
 
 
• **Example:** I visited the cobbler to get my old boots repaired.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cobbler**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tailor **(दर्जी): A person who makes or alters clothing.
 
 
• **Example:** The tailor stitched a beautiful gown for the wedding.
 
 
 
• **Plumber **(प्लंबर): A person who installs or repairs pipes and fixtures for water or gas.
 
 
• **Example:** We called the plumber to fix the leaky faucet in the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Mechanic **(मिस्त्री): A person who repairs and maintains machinery, especially motor vehicles.
 
 
• **Example:** The mechanic repaired my car engine in just two hours.
